name: LDPE Film Pouch
description: Low-Density Polyethylene flexible film. Good moisture barrier but very poor oxygen barrier. Inexpensive and widely available.

name: BOPP Film Pouch
description: Biaxially Oriented Polypropylene. Better clarity and stiffness than LDPE. Good moisture barrier, moderate oxygen barrier.

name: Metallised BOPP Pouch
typical_use_case: Chips, fried snacks, light-sensitive dry products
description: Aluminium-metallised BOPP. Excellent moisture and oxygen barrier. Blocks light. Used for chips and namkeen.

name: Aluminium Foil Laminate (PET / Al / PE)
typical_use_case: Ghee, butter, dairy fat products, tea, coffee
description: Multi-layer laminate with aluminium foil core. Near-zero WVTR and OTR. Perfect barrier for fat-rich, light-sensitive products.

name: PET / Al / PE Retort Pouch
typical_use_case: Ready-to-eat curries, mango pulp, high-moisture processed foods
description: Retort-grade multilayer pouch suitable for high-temperature sterilisation (121°C). Used for shelf-stable wet foods.

name: HDPE Rigid Container
description: High-Density Polyethylene blow-moulded jar or bottle. High crush resistance and good moisture barrier.

name: PET Bottle / Jar
typical_use_case: Edible oils, beverages, honey, dry spices
description: Clear Polyethylene Terephthalate bottle. Excellent clarity and mechanical strength. Moderate oxygen barrier.

name: PLA Bio-Plastic Pouch (Compostable)
typical_use_case: Organic grains, short shelf-life dry produce, eco packaging
description: Polylactic Acid bio-based film made from corn starch. Industrially compostable (100% biodegradable). Moderate barrier properties.

name: Kraft Paper Pouch with PE Liner
typical_use_case: Artisanal tea, coffee beans, organic pulses, flour
description: Natural unbleached Kraft paper exterior with thin food-grade inner plastic lining. Eco-friendly aesthetic.

name: EVOH High-Barrier Multilayer Film (PA/EVOH/PE)
typical_use_case: Fresh meat, cheese, modified atmosphere produce (MAP)
description: Ethylene Vinyl Alcohol copolymer co-extruded film. Ultra-high oxygen barrier while remaining transparent.

name: Glass Bottle / Jar
typical_use_case: Premium pickles, jams, honey, juices, oils
description: Amber or clear glass container. 100% impermeable to moisture, gases, and aromas. Fully recyclable. Heavy and fragile.

name: Tinplate Metal Can (Sanitary Can)
typical_use_case: Canned sweets (Gulab Jamun), fruit pulp, processed vegetables
description: Hermetically sealed tin-coated steel container. Indestructible physical and gas barrier.

name: Vacuum Shrink Pouch (PA/PE)
typical_use_case: Fresh paneer, cured meat, vacuum-packed vegetables
description: Polyamide (Nylon) / Polyethylene high-puncture shrink pouch for vacuum sealing.

name: Perforated Anti-Fog MAP Film
typical_use_case: Fresh spinach, berries, mushrooms, cut vegetables
description: Micro-perforated film engineered for active equilibrium modified atmosphere packaging of respiring produce.

name: Paperboard Folding Carton with Inner Liner
typical_use_case: Cereals, tea boxes, sweet boxes, bakery items
description: Rigid recycled paperboard outer box with protective inner pouch.
